label: ETV6::NTRK2

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
NTRK2 encodes TRKB, a receptor tyrosine kinase for brain-derived neurotrophic factor and neurotrophin-4.

The reported fusion retains the NTRK2 kinase region in an ETV6-containing product. ETV6::NTRK2 has been documented in metastatic pulmonary atypical carcinoid with a clinical response to entrectinib; evidence for this specific pairing includes individual cases.

An expressed oncogenic NTRK fusion can meet the NTRK solid-tumor biomarker definition for TRK inhibition; larotrectinib eligibility includes advanced disease, absence of known acquired resistance mutations, and prior progression or no satisfactory alternative.
